objective: Implement simulator-plan.md in full, including Stage 7

requirements: Stable saved identities for inventory, shipments, work, batches and connections; cancelled identities are not reused.
One game clock and complete resident time accounts.
Read-only diagnostics, exact continuation, seeded repeatability and atomic malformed-save rejection.
Compact, dispersed, empty-fund, blocked-access and established protected baselines.
Arrival, extraction, warehouse, worksite and project stores own their actual goods; summaries distinguish available, reserved, committed and travelling supplies.
Residents collect and deliver along clear paths, with bounded cargo, reserved receiving room and attendance before construction.
Near storage and useful roads reduce actual completion time; priorities and recent workload govern competing jobs.
Interruptions, blocked paths, full stores, cancellation, salvage, warehouse closure and relocation preserve ownership and capacity.
Travel, outside shifts, village work, meals, sleep and leisure use the same clock.
Shared reachable jobs respect needs, preferences, workload, agreements, useful working time and limited work positions.
Helping requests visibly accept, travel, wait, work, pause, finish or cancel without duplicate inputs or labour.
Conditional project and fund forecasts use the real simulation and invalidate when player plans change.
Hunger interrupts work, existing crops and overdue animals receive care, and balanced villages preserve individual sleep and substantial leisure.
Located saved batches use delivered inputs, labour, passive duration, targets and bounded output space.
Local camp/workshop manufacture and purchasing both support an actual housing expansion.
Kitchen pots, tools and shared meals use the same located ownership and real attendance.
Food dates survive carriage, refunds and cancellations; expiry is once-only and recovery remains possible.
Growth, digestion, filtration, banana treatment and curing progress independently when their conditions permit; interruptions preserve ownership.
Seeded fertility, retention, moisture, nutrients, shade, vegetation and finite local deposits persist.
Player-placed extraction depletes its own deposit; planted timber and bamboo grow and can be harvested and replanted.
Suitability changes real growth and yield; construction, roads, extraction and canopy have lasting local effects.
Delivered compost and attended restoration recover soil; depleted deposits and poor layouts retain practical recovery routes.
Grid overlays and placement previews explain the land before commitment without changing the world.
Fresh water, greywater, sealed sewage and reclaimed irrigation have separate located contents, compatible ports and owned process inputs.
Residents carry bounded, class-appropriate loads along actual routes; manual treated-water and sealed-service alternatives prevent dead ends.
Paid kits, local delivery and resident corridor work precede commissioned flow; priorities, capacity, pausing, dismantling and replacement preserve equipment and contents.
Connected circuits own generation, stored charge, consumption, curtailment and discharge; unconnected consumers cannot use distant supply and rooftop storage stays private.
Pumps need their actual cable connection; optional powered workshop work pauses safely on outage while manual starter work remains available.
Recovered batteries have visible locations, occupied plots, resident transport, safe interruption, charged ownership and once-only material salvage.
Saved seeded wet/dry conditions and forecasts consistently affect roots, rain capture, solar output and river generation.
Use and exposure wear owned equipment; warnings, spare parts, delivered kits and attended service allow recovery from failure.
Bounded useful practice grants gradual skills, including paid occupations, while novices retain ordinary work.
Supplier prices, finite offers and freight changes are predictable; confirmed receipts remain firm and essential goods remain available.
The completed village operates across repeated seasons with paid maintenance, healthy reserves, exact saves, valid accounts and majority waking village leisure.
Thirteen linear chapters teach all six systems through meaningful outcomes; earlier valid work counts and all twenty-one buildings have actionable introductions.
Primary goals are separate from 47 optional measurable lessons and seven reference guides; every building is not required for campaign completion.

Saved observation windows use reachable, unclaimed edible food, actual needs, household services, powered nights, leisure and dry-period comfort; spending and delivery challenges use actual transactions.
Both fresh minimal and complete optional campaigns finish through player commands, paid supplies, resident work, care and gatherings, with exact chapter checkpoints.
Five independent copies of one earned one-home village compare layout, method, outside work and preferences; each supports occupied housing, paid services, dry-weather operation and leisure.
A poorly placed home recovers through actual resident relocation and restored metered services.
First-fifteen-minute and first-week pacing are recorded; these are 1x clock equivalents, excluding reading time and automatic acceleration.
Sandbox retains free placement and comfortable defaults, with independently saved construction/supply, living-land and utility constraints; rules preserve existing property and orders.
Desktop controls, day/night artwork, cargo, overlays, blocked-work feedback, read-only panels and protected-save isolation pass rendered review.
Formatting, all native tests, strict all-target lint, WebAssembly, script syntax and every public verifier pass on the final engine.

limits: A completed local release does not authorize merging any pull request.
Hosted checks previously could not start because of account billing; recheck and record their actual final state.
The pre-pickup-fix pipeline and its artifacts are baseline evidence, not the final corrected release.
Scripted pacing and housing results describe the declared choices, not minimum possible player completion times.
